title: A Worldline instantons approach to the schwinger effect in scalar QED
author: Pedro Soares da Costa Mota e Souza
abstract: In this bachelor thesis the Schwinger Effect was studied in the framework of the quantum electrodynamics. Based on the original method developed by Schwinger to derive the pair production rate it was made an historical review. After that, as a warm up for the introduction of the Worldline Instantons approach to the problem, there is an introduction to instantons and their basic features and applications in physics. Finally, the Worldline formalism is discussed and a particular way of evaluation of the worldline path integral, the Worldline Instanton method. In particular, the Worldline Instantons approach was applied to the calculation of pair production rates in the presence of constants electric and magnetic background fields, an extension to the analysis made by Gordon(2015), where the authors considered a pure electric field. It is shown that the semiclassical calculations performed, in which we consider perturbations up to second order, resulting in the exact formula for the pair production rate obtained using another method by Kim(2006).
